diagnosis.root_cause: The subscriber's CATV service is provisioned and the ONU is online, but CATV synchronization is false. Internet service is functioning normally, so the fault is isolated to the CATV/RF path or ONU CATV tuner rather than EPON, VLAN, router, RADIUS, or general connectivity.
evidence: The complaint specifically concerns TV channels while internet service remains operational.
The subscriber is active, has CATV service enabled, uses a CATV-capable ONU, and is assigned profile_CATV.
The ONU is online, authenticated, responsive, and has a completed EPON exchange.
RX power is -20.4 dBm and TX power is approximately +2.45 dBm, both within normal EPON limits.

Optical telemetry is stable over seven days: RX variation is within the healthy noise range, TX variation is within the healthy noise range, distance is constant at 118, and TX bias current is healthy and stable.
The OLT, PON port, and router are healthy; all observed peers on EPON0/7 are online and have normal optical readings.
The customer VLAN is present and matches the expected VLAN 1037, and RADIUS/session state is consistent with normal internet service.
Session frequency, session duration, and traffic are normal, ruling out authentication or internet flapping as the cause.
The only abnormal service-specific state is catv_synced: 0, making a CATV/RF synchronization or CATV tuner fault the closest supported diagnosis.

remediation.action: Check the CATV RF input level, channel/frequency lock, and coaxial connectors at the ONU and premises. Verify the CATV optical/RF signal and splitter path for this subscriber, then resync or reprovision the CATV profile. If RF levels and cabling are normal but synchronization remains false, replace the ONU or its CATV module and retest channel acquisition.

ground_truth.root_cause: The customer is recorded as subscribed to CATV but catv_synced is 0, so the CATV state was never pushed to the ONU. Data service is unaffected; only the television service is missing.
expected_reasoning: The customer reports working internet and missing television
catv_service is 1 and catv_synced is 0, so the subscription exists and the device state does not match it
The ONU model supports CATV, so this is not an equipment limitation
Optical readings are normal and the live probe confirms the ONU is healthy
Sessions and daily traffic are normal, consistent with working data service
The OLT and router are healthy and no shared fault exists
This is a service state mismatch on one dimension, of the same class as the 84 unsynced lines in the estate
It is resolved by re-pushing the CATV state rather than by any field work
distractors: Every network signal is healthy, inviting a no_fault conclusion
The complaint could be read as customer equipment rather than provisioning
